content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-139. - Notice of assessment roll filing and hearing on objections.
content.summary:
Upon receiving the assessment roll made out by the engineer, the city clerk shall
               give notice of an assessment hearing, as provided in
section 78-100
.
(Code 1981, § 27-139; Ord. No. 551, § 80, 5-14-1964)
